office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the Pacific County Superior Court, keeping its records and handling its administrative and financial affairs.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Emma Rose (Prefers Independent Party), clerk since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Pacific County Superior Court Clerk since 2023, after three years in court administration; the only candidate.
highlights: Southwest District representative for the state association of county clerks [S1]
Says she has improved communication and access to information [S1]
